newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RMB jumps on retail move and profit view.
newsitem.headline: RMB jumps on retail move and profit view.

text.p: Shares in RMB Holdings Ltd surged on Monday as investors cheered the bank's move into private banking and the upbeat outlook for its full year bottom line.
"There's this announcement that the MD sees a higher profit and they've also announced that they're going into private banking...that's helping it," noted one broker from a European investment house.
RMB closed up 40 cent to 11.20 rand on turnover of about 1.7 million shares.
Dealers said the stock received an early fillip from two morning bookover deals of 590,000 shares each at 10.95 cents.
The group earlier announced it would launch a tailored investment and credit service for high net worth individuals from the first quarter of 1998.
Rand Merchant Bank managing director Paul Harris also said the group was ahead of budget in the second half and on track for higher profits for the year to June.
